mapper.sql: ppl.id AS id, ppl.ppl_code AS code, ppl.created AS `date`, ppl.title AS title, CONCAT(ppl.date_validate_from," - ",date_validate_to) AS validateThrough, c.id AS companyId, c.name AS companyName, cus.id AS organizationId, cus.name AS organizationName, pg.id AS productGroupId, pg.name AS productGroupName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_price_list_details ppd WHERE ppd.product_price_list_id = ppl.id) AS itemAmount, pt.id AS priceTypeId, pt.name AS priceTypeName, ppl.created As created, CONCAT(u.first_name, " ", u.last_name) AS createdBy, ppl.modified As modified, CONCAT(u2.first_name, " ", u2.last_name) AS modifiedBy, ppl.is_approve AS isApprove, ppl.is_active AS isClose

FROM product_price_lists ppl LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = ppl.company_id LEFT JOIN customers cus ON cus.id = ppl.customer_id LEFT JOIN pgroups pg ON pg.id = ppl.pgroup_id LEFT JOIN price_types pt ON pt.id = ppl.price_type_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ppl.created_by LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = ppl.modified_by
mapper.select:
SELECT products.id AS productId, products.name AS description, products.code AS model, (SELECT name FROM pgroups WHERE id = product_pgroups.pgroup_id) AS brand, products.price_uom_id AS uomId, (SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id = price_uom_id) AS uom, unit_cost AS price FROM products INNER JOIN product_pgroups ON products.id = product_pgroups.product_id INNER JOIN product_prices ON products.id = product_prices.product_id WHERE products.is_active = 1 AND products.company_id = #{filter.companyId} AND product_pgroups.pgroup_id = #{filter.productGroupId} AND product_prices.price_type_id = #{filter.priceTypeId} AND product_prices.uom_id = products.price_uom_id GROUP BY product_prices.product_id ORDER BY products.code
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT products.id) FROM product_price_list_details LEFT JOIN products ON product_price_list_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON product_price_list_details.uom_id = uoms.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON products.id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON product_pgroups.pgroup_id = pgroups.id WHERE products.is_active = 1 AND product_price_list_details.product_price_list_id = #{productPriceListId}

SELECT products.id AS productId, products.name AS description, products.code AS model, pgroups.name AS brand, product_price_list_details.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uom, product_price_list_details.note AS note, product_price_list_details.price AS price FROM product_price_list_details LEFT JOIN products ON product_price_list_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON product_price_list_details.uom_id = uoms.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON products.id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON product_pgroups.pgroup_id = pgroups.id WHERE products.is_active = 1 AND product_price_list_details.product_price_list_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_price_lists ( ppl_code, company_id, customer_id, title, date_validate_from, date_validate_to, pgroup_id, price_type_id, is_approve, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{productPriceList.code}, #{productPriceList.companyId}, #{productPriceList.customerId}, #{productPriceList.title}, #{productPriceList.dateValidateFrom}, #{productPriceList.dateValidateTo}, #{productPriceList.pgroupId}, #{productPriceList.priceTypeId}, #{productPriceList.isApproved}, NOW(), #{productPriceList.createdBy}, #{productPriceList.isActive} )

INSERT INTO product_price_list_details ( product_price_list_id, product_id, uom_id, price, note ) VALUES ( #{productPriceListDetail.productPriceListId}, #{productPriceListDetail.productId}, #{productPriceListDetail.uomId}, #{productPriceListDetail.price}, #{productPriceListDetail.note} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_price_lists SET `company_id`= #{productPriceList.companyId}, `customer_id`= #{productPriceList.customerId}, `title`= #{productPriceList.title}, `pgroup_id`= #{productPriceList.pgroupId}, `price_type_id`= #{productPriceList.priceTypeId}, `date_validate_from`= #{productPriceList.dateValidateFrom}, `date_validate_to`= #{productPriceList.dateValidateTo}, `modified` = NOW(), `modified_by`= #{productPriceList.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{productPriceList.id}
UPDATE product_price_lists SET is_approve = #{productListApproveStatus.status}, date_approve = NOW() WHERE id = #{productListApproveStatus.id};
mapper.select: SELECT ppl_code FROM product_price_lists WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(created) = YEAR(NOW()) AND ppl_code LIKE '%PPL%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
